items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: There were a lot of Benson bands.

ctx.x: I'm not going to be a man. I'm not going to be a man. I'm not going to be a man. I'm not going to be a man.

I told him, he said, where you from? I said, from here. Oh, man, that's all. He says, man, wait. Meet me tomorrow at the local. Man. Yes, the next morning, the next day I meet him at the local. He introduced me. The brothers brought me. At that time, you know, I don't know if the law is the same now. You had to be in Chicago, Chicago, and then place six months before you could take a study job. Yeah, stuff right now, too. Most places, yeah. Sometimes three months. Yeah, exactly. Well, I have my transfer card. So…
Benson, yeah. Benson officers. Benson, yeah.
